title: What Getting 3 Billion Views Taught Me About Human Psychology
description:
I've generated over 3 billion views for some of the most boring brands on the internet, like instant ramen, software tools, and cellphone plans. 

After years of doing this, I've come to realize that virality has nothing to do with the content itself, and everything to do with how the human brain works. 

In this video, I break down the 6 psychological principles I've used to make almost anything go viral.
